weak.text: The note is a file under notes/ named YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md, the slug three words at most
weak.reason: It checks only the filename pattern and slug length. A note with the wrong content, a missing frontmatter or no Next section would still pass it, so it says nothing about the structure the expected output asks for.
